verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents selecting several conversations at once and applying archive, label, or done to all of them together. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: a label picker that no longer re-sorts as labels are ticked, an Auto-archive account setting, automation rules, and swipe or command-bar snoozing of a single conversation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
